L01.why: Texts rarely concede an unexplained match; odd self-undermining role.

L02.why: Predicting decline of daily paper is an extreme, unusual move.

L03.why: Absolute denial 'at all' is typically too strong.

L04.why: 'Circular' is the most specific charge; others are broader.

L06.why: Procedural recommendation rarely the credited response to a claim.

L07.why: Flat denial of the reported data is usually too strong.

L08.why: Specific policy recommendation is an off-axis distractor shape.

L09.why: Withdrawing the central claim is an unlikely sentence function.

L10.why: 'Cannot be calibrated at all' is absolute.

L11.why: 'Inconsequential' least likely in a typical source context.

L12.why: Flat denial of a factual premise is usually too strong.

L13.why: Concession that wild birds solve without instruction seems off.

L14.why: Flat denial of a basic legal rule is usually too strong.

L15.why: 'Premonitory' is rare and unlikely to fit.

L16.why: 'Generous' is an odd fit among evaluative terms.
